context: Use a narrow non-autouse fixture or explicit patch for mocked execution tests and simulate low memory to prove isolation.
description: A prior macOS nightly flaked 22 mocked dataframe tests when the production memory precheck observed a roughly 0.4 GiB deficit; reruns passed. Classify tests that intend to exercise memory policy, then stub only mocked execution paths so ambient RAM cannot decide unrelated unit outcomes. Keep production guards unchanged.

preserves.behavior: Dedicated memory tests retain pass and fail coverage.
Real runs still abort when estimated memory exceeds available capacity.
